title: Reading the selected branch
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration of $D$ on input $x$. If $c$ is halted and its output is the one-bit word $[b]$, then after two steps the timed conditional machine, started from the control configuration associated with $c$, is in the ready configuration corresponding to the branch selected by $b$, with $c$'s input-head position and work tapes and heads retained.
hypotheses_covered: $D,M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
